svg.title: NCP ecosystem integration map
svg.desc: Informative UNRELEASED 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate ecosystem map. It lists eleven roles and four isolated Haldir processes. Its policy authority is not an NCP peer. X02 uses composite 1/2/3-drone sessions with 6N/3N frames and remains open. MUSIC owns shared clocks. SVG is presentation-only. Qualifications are not run. Not release or certification evidence.
